name: Shivam
bio: Visual artist working in portrait photography, cinematography, videography and video editing.
artist_vibe_summary: Shivam is a Delhi-based visual artist whose practice spans portrait photography, cinematography, and dynamic video editing. His work demonstrates a keen technical command over narrative pacing, audio-visual synchronization, and professional color grading. Operating with a polished aesthetic signature, he seamlessly translates real-world settings into cohesive, commercially viable visual storytelling.

multimodal_questions.question: Are the transitions between clips smooth and purposeful?
Is the visual pacing matched effectively to the background audio/music?
Is the color grading consistent across different shots in the sequence?
Does the edit tell a clear narrative or maintain a cohesive theme?
Are graphical overlays or text (if any) professionally integrated?
Does this image feature a portrait photography composition with a clear human subject?
Does this video demonstrate professional cinematography techniques such as stable camera movement and intentional lighting?
Does this footage show evidence of advanced videography setup and capture in a real-world setting?
Are there cuts, transitions, and pacing edits in this video that indicate professional video editing proficiency?
Does the visual style of this work reflect a cohesive artistic identity suitable for commercial visual arts?
